Adding the currently playing audio to an existing collection directly from the player.

Access to a help section or FAQ area within the app with answers to common questions.

Option to set up Two-Factor Authentication to further secure the account.
Display of a list of recent successful and failed login attempts with time, IP address, and device.
Display of a list of devices currently or recently connected to the account.
